post.description: Requires workspace administrator access. Select routing peers and consumers. Selection applies only to new connections. Existing routes default to Internet only. LAN/Tor modes require compatible agents. Established flows retain their selected exit.

routing_selectors.description: Ordered machine/group priorities for conflicting remote LAN prefixes. May be empty only when local Tor is enabled; LAN-only mode requires peer exits.

allow_direct_fallback.description: When all routing peers are unavailable, allow new connections over the client’s normal internet connection. Existing connections retain their original path. Disabled by default.

traffic_mode.description: All: internet and matching remote LANs. Internet only: internet through exits. LAN only: matching remote LANs through peers while internet stays local.

tor_enabled.description: Include the consumer’s own embedded Tor client for internet TCP traffic.

put.description: Requires workspace administrator access. Rejects routing loops and conflicting consumer assignments. Existing routes default to Internet only. LAN/Tor modes require compatible agents. Established flows retain their selected exit.

routing_selectors.description: Ordered machine/group priorities for conflicting remote LAN prefixes. May be empty only when local Tor is enabled; LAN-only mode requires peer exits.

allow_direct_fallback.description: When all routing peers are unavailable, allow new connections over the client’s normal internet connection. Existing connections retain their original path. Disabled by default.

traffic_mode.description: All: internet and matching remote LANs. Internet only: internet through exits. LAN only: matching remote LANs through peers while internet stays local.

tor_enabled.description: Include the consumer’s own embedded Tor client for internet TCP traffic.

delete.description: Requires workspace administrator access. Removes this route definition.

put.description: Requires workspace administrator access. Plain domains include subdomains by default; set include_subdomains=false for exact matching. A leading *. matches subdomains only, excluding the apex. An empty list clears the policy. Blocking is the only supported action; address replacement is rejected.

200.description: Machine block rules and can_manage permission

put.description: Requires ownership of the mapped port. Applies to direct HTTP access and proxies targeting that mapping. Omit secret to preserve an existing secret of the same mode. Temporary agent mappings cannot be edited.

secret.description: Six digits for pin; 16 to 72 bytes for key.

get.description: Checks current grant and membership without opening a destination connection. Returns ready=false until a peer’s authenticated notification connection is ready.

get.summary: Open an authorized gateway or peer stream
get.description: WebSocket upgrade on the existing API port. Each stream checks the grant and membership. Binary messages carry bytes; text eof half-closes the upload direction. Active permissions renew through a bounded lease.

101.description: Authenticated WebSocket stream or notification channel

get.summary: Accept a one-use peer proxy session
get.description: Only the selected peer identity may accept. The gateway sends current destination policy, and the provider reports destination_ip after connecting. Stream forwarding begins only after readiness. No extra listener is created.

101.description: Authenticated WebSocket stream or notification channel

get.description: A notification WebSocket exists only for a peer with an enabled UI grant and a valid authenticated private-sync lease. Text messages contain session IDs; ping/pong keeps the idle connection alive.

get.description: Fresh edge health and counters for the authenticated owner’s proxy bindings. Returns available=false when no fresh snapshot exists.

SessionCookie.name: porthub_session
SessionCookie.description: A signed-in platform administrator session. The cookie name can be configured by the operator.

PrivateAgentBearer.description: Private registration credential. Must be paired with the x-porthub-peer header. This grants no browser management permission.

id.description: Stable unique binding identifier; generated if omitted.

target_url.description: HTTP(S) target for standalone bindings. Managed target URLs are resolved by the server.

connection_data_id.description: Owned machine-port mapping ID for connection bindings.

health.description: Active HTTP probes, path, interval/timeout, failure/recovery thresholds, cooldown and healthy status range.
